title: Inducing Human-like Biases in Moral Reasoning Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures performance on moral reasoning tasks, specifically the Commonsense split of the ETHICS dataset. It does not measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze or report on any aspects related to religion. The study focuses on aligning large language models with human neural (fMRI) and behavioral data in the domain of general moral reasoning.
